request.prompt:
Domain: peatland fire detections (this is a fire study, not flood, not earthquake — frame accordingly). Processes such surveys consider include: hotspots burning out under suppression; smoldering peat surviving rain and restarting days later; spread into new grid cells downwind; containment holding at surveyed lines; flare-ups on previously quiet cells; or full cessation with no restart. These are vocabulary, not answers: you may adopt, adapt, or reject any of them, but your set must stay open and include a cessation story with real weight. Ground every weight in the ledger below, not in the vocabulary above.
Context: a peat-fire detection survey, five pre-cutoff days, anonymous grid cells. Below is the evidence ledger (pre-cutoff aggregates only).
Propose an OPEN mechanism set that includes a nothing-happens story with real weight, per-fact weights, and a spatial cluster rule. Reply with JSON only: {"mechanisms": [{"id", "title", "supports": [fact ids], "opposes": [fact ids], "prior"}], "weights": {fact id: number}, "cluster_rule": {"max_distance_m": number, "min_features": number}}. Cite only ledger facts, using their FULL ids exactly as written in the ledger lines below; any abbreviated id invalidates the draft. Assert no outcome.
Ledger facts:
- FF1_total_detections: 6142 VIIRS detections predate the cutoff
- FF2_burn_days: 5 distinct burn days in the window
- FF3_cells_with_fire: fire present in 30 grid cells
- FF4_hotspot_clumping: 6126 detections clumped near hot cells (>=3 detections)
- FF5_unbroken_run: longest gap between burn days: {'n_total': 6142, 'n_dated': 6142, 'n_distinct': 5, 'span_s': 4.0, 'max_gap_s': 1.0} days
- FF6_study_box: study box present as context (no time signal)

response.text: {"mechanisms": [{"id": "burnout_suppression", "title": "Hotspots burning out under suppression", "supports": ["FF1_total_detections", "FF4_hotspot_clumping"], "opposes": ["FF2_burn_days", "FF5_unbroken_run"], "prior": 0.17}, {"id": "smoldering_restart", "title": "Smoldering peat surviving rain and restarting days later", "supports": ["FF1_total_detections", "FF2_burn_days", "FF5_unbroken_run", "FF4_hotspot_clumping"], "opposes": ["FF6_study_box"], "prior": 0.18}, {"id": "spread_downwind", "title": "Spread into new grid cells downwind", "supports": ["FF3_cells_with_fire", "FF1_total_detections", "FF4_hotspot_clumping"], "opposes": ["FF6_study_box"], "prior": 0.15}, {"id": "containment_hold", "title": "Containment holding at surveyed lines", "supports": ["FF4_hotspot_clumping", "FF3_cells_with_fire", "FF6_study_box"], "opposes": ["FF1_total_detections", "FF2_burn_days"], "prior": 0.15}, {"id": "flareup_quiet", "title": "Flare-ups on previously quiet cells", "supports": ["FF3_cells_with_fire", "FF1_total_detections"], "opposes": ["FF4_hotspot_clumping", "FF5_unbroken_run"], "prior": 0.15}, {"id": "cessation", "title": "Full cessation with no restart", "supports": ["FF6_study_box"], "opposes": ["FF1_total_detections", "FF2_burn_days", "FF3_cells_with_fire", "FF4_hotspot_clumping", "FF5_unbroken_run"], "prior": 0.2}], "weights": {"FF1_total_detections": 0.85, "FF2_burn_days": 0.8, "FF3_cells_with_fire": 0.75, "FF4_hotspot_clumping": 0.9, "FF5_unbroken_run": 0.95, "FF6_study_box": 0.1}, "cluster_rule": {"max_distance_m": 1000, "min_features": 3}}
